THIS CRL.P. IS FILED U/S.482 OF CR.P.C. PRAYING TO 1.
QUASH THE COMPLAINT AND FIR FILED BY RESPONDENT POLICE STATED 26.10.2019 IN CR.NO.105/2019 BEFORE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C., DAVANAGERE IS AT ANNEXED AS A AND B. 2. QUASH THE CHARGE SHEET DATED 04.01.2020 AND FILED BY THE RESPONDENT POLICE AND PROCEEDINGS PENDING BEFORE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND J.M.F.C., DAVANAGERE IN C.C.NO.205/2020 IS AT ANNEXED AS C.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The first petitioner and the mother of the second petitioner who is no more are before this Court seeking the following prayers:
"1. quash the complaint and FIR filed by respondent police dated 26.10.2019 in Crime No.105/2019 before 2nd Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC,
Davanagere,i s at Annexted as A and B;
2. quash the charge sheet dated 04.01.2020 and filed by the respondent police and proceedings pending before the 2nd Additional Senior Civil Judge and NC:
2023:KHC:21238 JMFC, Davanagere in C.C.No.205/2020 is at Annexed as C."
2.
During the pendency of the present petition, the parties to the lis, the husband and wife have settled the disputed in O.S.No.301/2021 whereby the decree of divorce is granted.
The decree of divorce is under certain conditions.

The conditions insofar as it concerned in the present case reads as follows:
"The defendant has agreed to withdraw Crl.Misc.No.103/2020 filed under Section 12 of D V Act, which is pending on the file of II Addl. ACJ, Court, Channagiri.
The defendant has filed Crl.Misc.No.411/2022 u/s 125 Crpc. Claiming maintenance against the plaintiff, which came to be allowed.
In view of the settlement arrived at in this case the defendant agreed that she will not persue the same.

The defendant has lodged a complaint u/s 498 A IPC., in C.C.No.205/2020 on the file of 1st ACJ.,
Davanagere, against which the plaintiff has filed Crl.Petition No.3098/2021 for quashing of the FIR., which is pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka.
The Plaintiff has agreed to get the same disposal of by the Hon'ble High of Karnataka in view of the settlement arrived at in this case."

opennyai_summary.decision:
The conditions insofar as it concerned in the present case reads as follows:
"The defendant has agreed to withdraw Crl.Misc.No.103/2020 filed under Section 12 of D V Act, which is pending on the file of II Addl. ACJ, Court, Channagiri.
The Plaintiff has agreed to get the same disposal of by the Hon'ble High of Karnataka in view of the settlement arrived at in this case."
In the light of settlement arrived at between the parties which recognizes the closure of the proceedings and the fact of the offences being the ones punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC, I deem it appropriate to accept the settlement and quash the proceedings against the petitioner.
For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER a.
Criminal Petition is disposed of.
